section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 2000
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 2000 N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) 1.3.7.2 The Table-1.9 presents the rate of Road Accidental Deaths per thousand registered motor vehicles in each State & UT. It is observed that although Maharashtra & Gujarat States had the highest and the second highest number of registered vehicles in the country, the rate of Accidental Deaths per thousands vehicles was highest in Himachal Pradesh at 5.4 compared to 1.7 at the national level. The rate of death per 100 cases was highest in Mizoram at 98.4 compared to 26.0 at national level. As in the previous year, Lakshadweep did not report any death due to Road Accident.
